units.source_text: 他们刚要往回走，只见樱花林对面高松树下的折凳旁边，

en.t: Just as they were about to turn back, they saw beside the folding stools under the tall pines across from the cherry grove,

units.source_text: 有六七个朝鲜女子身穿朝鲜服装，敲着朝鲜大鼓，跳起了朝鲜舞。

en.t: six or seven Korean women in Korean dress beating large Korean drums and beginning to dance a Korean dance.

units.source_text: 这边的情景远比那边的要幽雅得多。

en.t: The scene on this side was far more refined and graceful than the one over there.

units.source_text: 透过松林墨绿的枝叶间隙，也可以窥见山樱的花。

en.t: Through gaps in the dark green branches and leaves of the pine grove, the blossoms of the mountain cherries could also be glimpsed.
